every_position_composed.reason: Site 1 keeps the 3D factory line cleanly framed across frames 1 to 9, whereas Site 2 has text overlapping the 3D subject in frame 3 and an empty 3D scene in frames 6 and 9.

type_and_layout.reason: Site 1 maintains a consistent, readable top-left card across frames 1 to 9 that gives the 3D scene room, unlike Site 2's shifting panels that clip at viewport edges in frames 3, 6, and 7.

overall.reason: Site 1 delivers a cohesive, unbroken scroll journey with an intuitive visual metaphor that clearly explains how Straitjacket works without layout collisions.
